data.action: 裹深蓝浴巾侧坐于桧木汤池边，手握冰牛奶瓶，红叶水雾缭绕，双颊酡红含羞浅笑直视观众
data.camera: front view, eye level, cowboy shot
data.description: 合宿度假村的露天温泉内，红叶在夜色中的池水旁徐徐飘落。优香身上紧裹着一件深蓝色的浴巾长浴袍，双肩泛着被泉水熏蒸的诱人红晕，端坐在桧木汤池边缘。她手里捧着一瓶刚从自动贩卖机买来的冰牛奶，深蓝色的双马尾在水雾中微卷。微凉的夜风吹拂过她发烫的耳垂，她害羞地低头喝了一小口牛奶，眼神偷偷瞄向身旁的老师，嘴角忍不住泛起甜蜜的微笑。
data.lighting: 温泉竹灯笼暖黄微光与夜雾柔光
data.mood: 度假温泉的微醺甜意与少女悸动
data.nsfwProse: She wears a dark blue bath towel wrap tucked snug across her chest, glistening with warm steam droplets across her bare shoulders, cleavage, and legs.
data.promptProse: Hayase Yuuka sits along the hinoki timber edge of a private outdoor hot spring on an autumn night, wrapped snugly in a dark blue bath towel beaded with moisture over her bare shoulders and cleavage. Holding a chilled glass milk bottle with heat-flushed cheeks and a shy smile, she faces the viewer amid swirling steam and warm bamboo lantern light.
data.title: 早濑优香 · 温泉水雾中的惬意微醺
data.animaCaption: Seated sideways along the hinoki edge of an outdoor hot spring in a snug dark-blue bath wrap, she holds a chilled glass milk bottle and meets the viewer with flushed cheeks and a shy smile. Warm bamboo lantern light glows through rising steam and drifting autumn leaves.
